package com.x.test;
import org.testng.annotations.Test;
public class BDeltaTest extends BBaseTest {
  @Test
  public void viaBase() { checkRange(compute()); }
  @Test
  public void viaOwn() { this.sameAsTwo(compute()); }
  private void sameAsTwo(int v) { assertEquals(v, 2); }
  private int compute() { return 2; }
  public static class Inner {
    @Test
    public void viaEnclosing() { checkRange(2); }
  }
}
